lines.text: The root is Man! Mandate, manuscript.
Mandate: something put in hand, an order.
Quick quiz! Which means written by hand?
Manuscript! It means written by hand.

words.mean: something put in hand, an order
words.ex: The new government has a mandate to reform the tax system.
The editor returned the manuscript with reviewers' comments.
